headline: Project Engineer (Civil)
summary: Licensed civil engineer with seven years managing road, school and commercial building projects in Zamboanga del Sur. I plan and track projects, prepare quantities and cost estimates, check work on site with the survey crew, and enforce construction safety. I use Procore and AutoCAD daily.

experience.title: Project Engineer
experience.employer: Pagadian Bay Construction and Development Corp.
bullets: Manage road and school building projects worth up to ₱180 million from mobilisation to turnover.
Prepare schedules, quantity take-offs and progress billings.
Run coordination meetings with subcontractors and the client and track issues in Procore.
Inspect work and safety on site every day with the foreman and safety officer.

experience.title: Site Engineer
bullets: Supervised concrete and earthworks on road and drainage projects.
Checked lines and levels with the survey crew and prepared as-built drawings in AutoCAD.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering
